review_method: Codex same-agent direct English-to-Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase; not an independent review or native-human review

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A and B are equal exactly when every member of A belongs to B and conversely.
samples.checked: Both directions retained; equality is not merely equal cardinality.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Prove that there is at most one empty set; two sets with no members must be equal.
Every A member is a B member. Strict subset additionally requires A not equal B.

samples.checked: The singleton-zero nested-set example is unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Bounded universal uses membership as antecedent of implication; bounded existential conjoins membership.

samples.checked: Zero convention retained despite different school-text convention.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The union of a set of sets contains objects in at least one member set.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Ordered pairs are equal exactly when first components match and second components match.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The product is partitioned into n disjoint rows of m ordered pairs each, giving n times m members.

legitimate_exceptions: Ruth is the original proper name inside a mathematical example; Richard is transliterated in prose.
Formula symbols, macro/token keys, file paths, source comments, identifiers and cross-reference keys remain in the source convention.
The mathematical function name len remains an identifier.
Two external-label conditionals render their original false branch in the chapter-only reader; editable translation preserves their full source-aligned content.
corrected_defects: Removed an unintended repeated x token in the set-builder explanation.
Replaced repetitive iff wording with a two-direction expression.
Rejected बहुपद as tuple terminology because it denotes polynomial.
Restored upstream power-set, binary-set, length and set-abstraction notation in the render adapter.
Preserved original diagram colors after adapter comparison.
remaining_uncertainty: Some specialized terms are explicitly provisional; details in TERM_DECISIONS.jsonl.
Several native web originals remain unavailable despite bounded acquisition attempts; observation hashes are not source-byte hashes.
This is one complete chapter, not the complete Marathi edition; 715 source units remain.
Same-agent review cannot establish the absence of all semantic or linguistic defects.
